name: Mask Singer
description: Twelve celebrities are masked under spectacular costumes, with their identity hidden. They compete by singing their own versions of songs, and the judges and audience must guess who is behind each mask!

Émission 07 : Final
videos.overview: For the MASK SINGER Grand Finale, three iconic characters from previous seasons will sing duets with the three finalists! The new investigator for the season, MICHAËL YOUN, along with his colleagues CHANTAL LADESOU, LAURENT RUQUIER and KEV ADAMS, will make one last attempt to guess the identities of the three remaining personalities in the competition, before unmasking them and revealing the season's big winner!
